Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all
why then are they baptized for the dead?
Again
what will they do who are given baptism for the dead? if the dead do not come back at all
why are people given baptism for them?

Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven
but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
And if anyone says a word against the Son of man
he will have forgiveness: but for him who says evil words against the Holy Spirit
there will be no forgiveness.

they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.
